[Changelog](https://bloom.diy/changelog) May 28, 2026


# Opus 4.8 in Bloom


Opus 4.8 is now available in Bloom. It’s a bit smarter across the board, but more importantly, it’s more efficient. Meaning it will use fewer credits to get the same work done compared to Opus 4.7.
